# Edelsteins, Faegenburg, & Blyakher

> > Brooklyn-based personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, brain injuries, construction accidents, and medical malpractice with three generations of legal expertise since 1937.

Edelsteins, Faegenburg, & Blyakher is a premier personal injury law firm serving New York City and Brooklyn. The firm combines decades of experience with specialized expertise across multiple injury categories, from motor vehicle accidents to catastrophic injuries.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Car Accidents
- Brain Injuries
- Construction Accidents
- Medical Malpractice
- Catastrophic Injuries
- Negligence Claims
- Drunk Driving
- Pedestrian Accidents
- Motorcycle Accidents
- Paul J. Edelstein
- Glenn K. Faegenburg
- Arthur Blyakher
- Brooklyn
- New York City

## Core Practice Areas

- [NYC Personal Injury Attorney](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-personal-injury-lawyers): General NYC personal injury legal services for accident and negligence claims
- [NYC Car Accident Attorneys](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-car-accident-lawyers): Specialized car accident attorneys serving NYC motor vehicle accident victims
- [NYC Brain Injury Attorneys](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-brain-injury-lawyers): Traumatic brain injury legal representation for NYC accident victims
- [Brooklyn Catastrophic Injury Lawyer](https://edelsteinslaw.com/brooklyn-catastrophic-injury-lawyer): Catastrophic injury representation for spinal cord and severe disability cases
- [NYC Construction Accident Attorneys](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-construction-accident-lawyers): Construction site injury and workers compensation legal services in NYC
- [NYC Medical Malpractice Lawyer](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-medical-malpractice-lawyers): Medical malpractice litigation for surgical errors and misdiagnosis claims
- [NYC Drunk Driving Accident Attorney](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-drunk-driving-accident-lawyers): Drunk driving accident representation with dram shop liability expertise
- [NYC Motorcycle Accident Lawyers](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-motorcycle-accident-lawyers): Motorcycle accident injury representation and negligence claims in NYC
- [New York City Pedestrian Accident Attorneys](https://edelsteinslaw.com/nyc-pedestrian-accident-lawyers): Pedestrian accident and hit-and-run legal representation in NYC
- [Practice Areas Overview](https://edelsteinslaw.com/practice-areas): Overview of practice areas including car, construction, and brain injuries
